test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 03 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A policeman sees a chain snatcher at a distance of 500 m. He starts chasing the chain snatcher who is running with a speed of 5 m/s while the policeman is chasing him with a speed of 15 m/s. What is the distance covered by the chain snatcher when he is caught by the policeman?
solution:
Given:

A policeman sees a chain snatcher at a distance of 500 m.

Speed of the snatcher = 5 m/s

Speed of the policeman = 15 m/s

Concept used:

1. Time taken to meet for two objects coming towards each other = Intermediary distance ÷ Relative speed

2. Relative speed is the difference between individual speeds while two objects run in the same direction.

3. Distance = Speed × Time

4. km/h = 5/18 m/s

Calculation:

Time taken to catch the snatcher by the policeman = 500 ÷ (15 - 5) = 50 seconds

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3284440430bee8e6c457162d56e92a6357b17b8bda92cbb7d665e8560d282856.png] 

Now, the distance covered by the chain snatcher when he is caught by the policeman = 50 × 5 = 250 m

**∴ The distance covered by the chain snatcher when he is caught by the policeman is 250 m.**
